question: Should AG-UI be accepted as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or should the same plugin package be published and supported as an external ClawHub/npm channel?
rationale: The repository policy prefers optional channel integrations outside core when the plugin seam is sufficient, while the contributor argues current bundled-channel tooling makes external ownership unsuitable. That tradeoff determines the correct packaging, dependency, support, and security ownership model.

options.title: External plugin by default
options.body: Publish the existing plugin package through ClawHub/npm and keep core changes limited to any demonstrably missing generic plugin seam.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled channel
options.body: Accept the channel in core, authorize its dependencies, preserve its runtime in the root package, and assign an owner for the new inbound HTTP/auth surface.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the PR open but do not continue integration work until a channel-ownership policy decision is recorded.

recommendation.title: External plugin by default
recommendation.body: Publish the existing plugin package through ClawHub/npm and keep core changes limited to any demonstrably missing generic plugin seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the upstream implementation and have provided the clearest concrete rationale for the proposed bundled-channel direction.
